instruction: Look at freecad_task-14_input.step in FreeCAD. Use the Part Design workbench for the modeling operations; activate or create the relevant Body, create new sketches for sketch-based features, and use GUI feature or placement tools for the requested edits. Add a horizontal cylindrical crossbar between the tops of the two posts and fuse it with the posts. The crossbar axis is along X, its center height is Z=40 mm, its diameter is 10 mm, and its length is 50 mm. Export the single fused U-shaped handle as /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-14_output.step. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
